base.must_reproduce: hybrid without a reranker returns, for all 40 questions, the sealed run's top 5 (row id, version, status, in order) and page-level Recall@5 is 18/28; otherwise the reranker is not called and no rerank number is reported

reranker.passage: the full stored row content, including the [source] first line
reranker.score: raw logit, no sigmoid, used for ordering only
reranker.ties: equal scores keep the hybrid order
reranker.beyond_candidates: rows after the first 30 keep their hybrid order behind the reranked ones; nothing is dropped
reranker.revision: not pinned at registration (the model hub was unreachable from where this was written); each run records the snapshot commit it loaded

metrics.page_recall_at_5: answerable: a top-5 hit whose source line names <doc>.pdf and a page in `pages`; reported for hybrid and for hybrid + rerank, with the questions gained and lost
metrics.mrr_at_5: answerable: 1 / rank of the first top-5 hit on a gold page, 0 if none; mean over the 28 answerable questions
metrics.candidate_ceiling: answerable: one of the first 30 hybrid candidates is on a gold page; also the rank at which a gold page first appears
metrics.unauthorized: store rows the caller may not read or from the restricted copies; forbidden citations; top-5 hits from the copies; reranker passages with a restricted marker or outside what the caller may read; embedder texts with a restricted marker; X01 and X02 return nothing and never reach the reranker
metrics.latency: per question: hybrid search, search with reranking, reranker inference; median / p95 / max; model load and warm-up reported separately

decision_rule.unauthorized: every unauthorized counter is 0 and both extra questions return nothing
decision_rule.guardrail: the 47-question guardrail registered in preparation/s2/evaluation/rerank passes
decision_rule.otherwise: not adopted; reported as measured; report_desk._build_service stays as it is

sets_already_used: the 40 questions were used by the 2026-11-06 QA run and its per-question analysis; the 47 synthetic questions were used by the hybrid comparison and the answerability check. No reranker was run on either before this registration.
